about: The pulse: weekly totals from public vulnerability sources, for products and vendors relevant to Portugal, kept as a history. Weak signals, not an audit. Aggregates only.
state_note: No source has been collected yet (data.b@PrompTugal.dinis was asked on 18 November 2026). No figure is published until it is read from a source on the register, with its time read and licence.
limits: never a list of IPs, hosts, devices, domains or exposed services
no victim data and no link to a leak site
anything specific to an organisation reported privately to CERT.PT or CNCS, never published
no scanning or probing of our own
no cell under 5 is shown on its own (it is merged or shown as fewer than 5)
